name: migrate_logger
description: Migrates .js/.mjs files in a directory from log(level, ...args) to logger.<level>(...args), swaps the log import for logger, renames formatId to formatID. Returns changed files and any leftover unmigrated log( calls.
whenToUse: For the logger API migration of a directory of modules; reusable for further directories.

dir.description: Directory relative to project root, e.g. src/modules

provenance.reason: migrate 24 modules now and more directories later
